story: Sophie and her friend Mia are sitting at the big art table. [emotion:QT/sad] Sophie is looking for her red crayon, but the red crayon is not there. Mia sees the red crayon on the floor under the chair. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Mia share the red crayon and start drawing colorful pictures together.
